_about: Service buildings for newfrance_setup.py. Key = imported building name (services have no _L1_WxD in the name; their lot is given here). kind = fire/police/hospital/school/post/landmark (templates from the Chicago Region Pack; landmark = its unique library park). Points are GPT lot metres (front-left origin, +Y to the rear). values = our numbers over the template's, per component. Remove an entry and re-run the setup to drop the service wiring. name/description = the menu name and tooltip written beside the prefab as <key>_en-US.loc; a picture at NewFrance/thumbnails/<key>.png becomes the asset-bar icon. kind park = a repeatable park monument (landmark without the one-per-city rule); drop = template components to leave out. unlock = the vanilla development-tree node that unlocks it (monuments use the first Parks node).

NA_PdDCaserneArcCanal.name: Caserne de l’Arc-du-Canal
NA_PdDCaserneArcCanal.description: Fire station. Three engine bays under limestone arches, with a brick hose tower that doubles as the quarter’s lookout. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDHotelDeVilleDeuxRives.name: Hôtel de Ville des Deux-Rives
NA_PdDHotelDeVilleDeuxRives.description: City hall and landmark. A brick and limestone town hall with a tall clock campanile over the square. One per city; raises attractiveness and gives residents somewhere to linger. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDCommissariatQuais.name: Commissariat des Quais
NA_PdDCommissariatQuais.description: Police station. A turreted brick commissariat with a clock tower and two patrol-car bays facing the quay. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDCliniqueTuiles._note: clinic: the Chicago hospital template scaled down (500 patients/30 ambulances -> 150/10)
NA_PdDCliniqueTuiles.name: Clinique des Tuiles
NA_PdDCliniqueTuiles.description: Neighbourhood clinic. Steep patterned-tile roofs over a brick and stone dispensary, with ambulance bays at the side. A smaller companion to the Hôpital des Invalides. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDLyceeOrmes.name: Lycée des Ormes
NA_PdDLyceeOrmes.description: High school. A domed central pavilion between two brick classroom wings, set back behind its forecourt. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDHotelPostesBassin.name: Hôtel des Postes du Bassin
NA_PdDHotelPostesBassin.description: Post office. A mansard-roofed postal hall with a clock over the door and van bays for the sorting room. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDHopitalInvalides.name: Hôpital des Invalides
NA_PdDHopitalInvalides.description: Hospital. Brick ward wings gathered around a gilded dome, with a covered ambulance entrance. The district’s main hospital. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDFacultePantheon.name: Faculté du Panthéon
NA_PdDFacultePantheon.description: College. A limestone portico and drum dome between two brick lecture wings. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDBibliothequeGenevieve.name: Bibliothèque Geneviève
NA_PdDBibliothequeGenevieve.description: Public library and landmark. A long reading room carried on a stone arcade, lit by a row of arched windows. One per city; raises attractiveness and offers quiet leisure. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDEcoleRuelle.name: École de la Ruelle
NA_PdDEcoleRuelle.description: Elementary school. A two-storey brick schoolhouse with a bell lantern and clock over the entrance. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDEcoleQuai.name: École du Quai
NA_PdDEcoleQuai.description: Elementary school. A low brick schoolhouse with a corner stair turret and a gabled entrance. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDColonneEcluse.name: Colonne de l’Écluse
NA_PdDColonneEcluse.description: Park monument. A limestone column banded in bronze and crowned by a verdigris lantern, raised to mark the opening of the canal lock in 1834. Stands on a gravel rond-point with clipped hedges. Place as many as you like. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDKiosqueMariniers.name: Kiosque des Mariniers
NA_PdDKiosqueMariniers.description: Park bandstand. An octagonal iron kiosk with a zinc roof and gilded finial, where the boatmen’s band plays on Sunday afternoons. Place as many as you like. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDSquareColonneMorris.name: Square de la Colonne Morris
NA_PdDSquareColonneMorris.description: Pocket square. A green advertising column pasted with theatre posters beside a cast-iron drinking fountain, on a single paved cell. Fits the gaps a city leaves over. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDArcDeuxRives.name: Arc des Deux-Rives
NA_PdDArcDeuxRives.description: Park monument. A triumphal arch in pale limestone, inscribed AUX BATELIERS DES DEUX RIVES, to the boatmen of both banks. Paved through the arch so a promenade can pass under it. Place as many as you like. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDFontaineGrotte.name: Fontaine de la Grotte
NA_PdDFontaineGrotte.description: Park fountain. A rusticated grotto wall with a pediment, bronze urns in its niches and a long basin with two jets, in the manner of a Paris garden fountain. Place as many as you like. Paris on the Delaware.

NA_PdDUsineEauxClaires._note: R8 utility (water_pump), wired as a placeable monument until a water_pump template is found; GPT's connection point None
NA_PdDUsineEauxClaires.description: Waterworks (decorative for now). A limestone temple fronts the river pumping works, with brick engine rooms and intake grilles on the quay side. Paris on the Delaware.
NA_PdDUsineEauxClaires.name: Usine des Eaux Claires

NA_PdDChateauEauOrmes._note: R8 utility (water_tower), wired as a placeable monument until a water_tower template is found; GPT's connection point [20, 1.5]
NA_PdDChateauEauOrmes.description: Water tower (decorative for now). Eight brick piers carry a broad corbelled water tank beneath a low slate roof and lantern. Paris on the Delaware.
NA_PdDChateauEauOrmes.name: Château d’eau des Ormes

NA_PdDCentraleSoleil._note: R8 utility (power), wired as a placeable monument until a power template is found; GPT's connection point [49, 42]
NA_PdDCentraleSoleil.description: Generating station (decorative for now). A brick generating station marks the quay with a stained-glass sunburst, a roof monitor, and two chimney stacks. Paris on the Delaware.
NA_PdDCentraleSoleil.name: Centrale du Soleil

NA_PdDTourDesOndes._note: R8 utility (telecom), wired as a placeable monument until a telecom template is found; GPT's connection point [28, 1.5]
NA_PdDTourDesOndes.description: Radio tower (decorative for now). Four brick piers carry an open iron lattice and an antenna above the city’s broadcast offices. Paris on the Delaware.
NA_PdDTourDesOndes.name: Tour des Ondes

NA_PdDOperaDesDeuxFleuves.description: Landmark. A grand staircase and limestone loggia lead into the river city's opera house beneath a green copper dome. One per city; raises attractiveness. Paris on the Delaware.
NA_PdDOperaDesDeuxFleuves.name: Opéra des Deux-Fleuves

NA_PdDNotreDameDelaware.description: Landmark. Twin brick towers, a limestone rose, and a slate flèche crown the cathedral above a compact city parvis. One per city; raises attractiveness. Paris on the Delaware.
NA_PdDNotreDameDelaware.name: Notre-Dame de la Delaware

_about_ZS1: Lobstertown civic set (ZS1, 2026-11-17): built by gemini lt_designs/civic.py, names NA_LT<Design>_L1_WxD (the lot is in the name). water and power use templates from other packs (see TEMPLATES in newfrance_setup.py); the transfer barn is a decorative park (no garbage template in any installed mod).

NA_LTFireStation_L1_4x4.name: Lobstertown Engine House
NA_LTFireStation_L1_4x4.description: Fire station. Three arched engine bays in a fieldstone ground floor, a shingled bunk room above and a stone hose tower at the back. Lobstertown.

NA_LTConstabulary_L1_4x4.name: Harbour Constabulary
NA_LTConstabulary_L1_4x4.description: Police station. A steep-roofed fieldstone station house with a corner stair turret and two carriage doors for the patrol cars. Lobstertown.

NA_LTCottageHospital_L1_4x4.name: Lobstertown Cottage Hospital
NA_LTCottageHospital_L1_4x4.description: Clinic. A shingled cottage hospital behind a long verandah, with two stone ward wings round a court and ambulance doors at the front. Lobstertown.

NA_LTGrammarSchool_L1_4x5.name: Lobstertown Grammar School
NA_LTGrammarSchool_L1_4x5.description: Elementary school. Arched fieldstone classrooms under a shingled upper floor and a hipped roof with a louvred cupola. Lobstertown.

NA_LTAcademy_L1_5x6.name: Lobstertown Academy
NA_LTAcademy_L1_5x6.description: High school. Three storeys of fieldstone and shingle with a clock stage on the ridge and two classroom wings round a court. Lobstertown.

NA_LTPostOffice_L1_3x3.name: Lobstertown Post Office
NA_LTPostOffice_L1_3x3.description: Post office. A fieldstone hall under a big shingled gable, a round corner turret and a carriage door for the mail van. Lobstertown.

NA_LTTownHall_L1_4x5.name: Lobstertown Town Hall
NA_LTTownHall_L1_4x5.description: Town hall and landmark. A fieldstone arcade under a great shingled gable with a belfry on the ridge and a stair turret. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTLibrary_L1_4x4.name: Lobstertown Free Library
NA_LTLibrary_L1_4x4.description: Public library and landmark. A long fieldstone reading room with arched windows, a steep slate roof and a turret with a lookout. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTWaterworks_L1_3x3.name: Lobstertown Waterworks
NA_LTWaterworks_L1_3x3.description: Water pumping station. A fieldstone pump house drawing groundwater, with a steep roof, a louvred cupola and a tall stone stack. Lobstertown.

NA_LTPowerhouse_L1_4x5.name: Lobstertown Powerhouse
NA_LTPowerhouse_L1_4x5.description: Power plant. A two-storey fieldstone and shingle engine house with two tall stone stacks. Lobstertown.

NA_LTTransferBarn_L1_3x3.name: Lobstertown Transfer Barn
NA_LTTransferBarn_L1_3x3.description: Decorative. A fieldstone barn with arched wagon doors under a big gable, to stand in front of the town's garbage works. Lobstertown.

NA_LTSirenTheatre_L1_4x5.name: Siren Theatre
NA_LTSirenTheatre_L1_4x5.description: Theatre and landmark. A brick opera house whose doors sit inside a giant cream scallop shell, with copper-capped stair towers and a mermaid in the pediment. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTCarouselHouse_L1_3x3.name: Seahorse Carousel House
NA_LTCarouselHouse_L1_3x3.description: Landmark. A glazed octagon round a carousel, a scalloped valance, iron seahorses on every corner and a striped ogee dome. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTLobstermensLodge_L1_3x3.name: Lobstermen's Lodge No. 1
NA_LTLobstermensLodge_L1_3x3.description: Landmark. A navy clapboard lodge hall with lancet windows and a twelve-metre red lobster sprawled across the ridge. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTTidewaterAquarium_L1_4x3.name: Tidewater Aquarium
NA_LTTidewaterAquarium_L1_4x3.description: Landmark. A granite rotunda under a copper dome, an iron octopus wrapped round the door and fish swimming round the drum. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTExhibitionHall_L1_6x5.name: Saltwater Exhibition Hall
NA_LTExhibitionHall_L1_6x5.description: Landmark. A glass and iron barrel vault between granite aisles, a scallop fan at each end, cast iron seahorses on the piers and a copper whale on the ridge. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTMaritimeCollege_L1_6x6.name: Maine Maritime College
NA_LTMaritimeCollege_L1_6x6.description: College and university. Three storeys of Richardsonian fieldstone and weathered shingle with a corner stair turret, ridge clock tower and twin lecture wings round a court. Lobstertown.

NA_LTGeneralHospital_L1_6x5.name: Lobstertown General Hospital
NA_LTGeneralHospital_L1_6x5.description: Full-capacity hospital. A three-storey fieldstone and shingle main pavilion behind a wide verandah, crowned with a ridge cupola, with three ambulance bays and twin stone ward wings. Lobstertown.

NA_LTKingCrabPalace_L1_5x4.name: King Crab Palace
NA_LTKingCrabPalace_L1_5x4.description: Seaside bathhouse and landmark. A pompous Beaux-Arts granite and cream pavilion under a striped melon dome crowned by an eleven-metre red King Crab hoisting a copper lantern, with starfish medallions over every arched window. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTSacredCodExchange_L1_5x4.name: The Sacred Cod Exchange
NA_LTSacredCodExchange_L1_5x4.description: Harbour fish market and landmark. A brick and granite arched market hall with a grand front clock gable, twin copper towers topped with crossed red lobster claws, and a fourteen-metre copper cod leaping across the ridge. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTSeaTurtlePavilion_L1_4x4.name: The Great Sea Turtle Pavilion
NA_LTSeaTurtlePavilion_L1_4x4.description: Unique coastal landmark. An oval verdigris-copper sea-turtle carapace with raised hexagonal scutes and a pale stone marginal border crowns an arched granite pavilion, with a proud arched turtle neck and head projecting over the entrance, broad swept-back paddle flippers along the sides, and a tapered tail behind. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTClipperBowHall_L1_4x5.name: The Clipper's Bow Maritime Hall
NA_LTClipperBowHall_L1_4x5.description: Maritime museum and landmark. A granite hall whose upper front projects forward as a sculpted clipper-ship prow with a copper figurehead, porthole medallions, twin giant cast-iron anchors framing the doors, and a crow's-nest lookout on the ridge. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTNautilusMarineGallery_L1_4x3.name: Nautilus Marine Gallery
NA_LTNautilusMarineGallery_L1_4x3.description: Unique landmark. A Beaux-Arts limestone and cream marine gallery with porthole-trimmed copper-hipped wings, a spiral nautilus entrance relief, and a colossal three-dimensional chambered nautilus shell coiling atop the central pavilion. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.

NA_LTWalrusBathhouse_L1_5x4.name: Walrus Bathhouse
NA_LTWalrusBathhouse_L1_5x4.description: Unique landmark. A Gilded-Age granite and silver-shingle coastal thermal bathhouse beneath a blue-grey slate mansard and twin octagonal copper cupolas, crowned by a reclining thirteen-metre copper walrus with sweeping ivory tusks. One per city; raises attractiveness. Lobstertown.
